inputs.checklistItemText: Transformer pads lack minimum 15-foot clearance from fire lanes
inputs.question: Are transformer pads shown on this fire protection plan? If so, what is their distance from designated fire lanes? Are fire lanes clearly marked and dimensioned?

output.reasoning: The agent is performing progressive verification by first asking whether transformer pads are present on the plan and whether fire lanes are marked/dimensioned. Although the requirement ultimately demands a 15-foot clearance measurement, the agent question begins with presence and feature-identification checks (sheet discovery, feature visibility, marking clarity) before any distance measurement would occur.
